correctness.rationale: Since \(rbx_1/(k_2+x_1)<rb\), pulse values satisfy \(x_2((n+1)T^+)\le qx_2(nT^+)\), \(q=(1-\omega)e^{(B+rb)T}\). Thus \(q<1\) forces extinction; when \(q=1\), eventual boundedness of \(x_1\) replaces \(rb\) by a strict smaller bound and again forces extinction. For the source biological parameters and \((\gamma,\omega,T)=(0.1,0.5,0.01)\), all printed Theorem 3.8 hypotheses hold, \(T_{\max}=0.005246815758790803\ldots<T\), but \(q=0.608567660439097\ldots<1\).
